policy.purpose: Preserve latent, forgotten, underserved, ignored and unresolved research paths without converting absence into evidence.

records.reason: Dynamic-system and attractor language appears in the ecosystem, but no canonical executable Poincare section was located.
records.risk_if_ignored: Recurrence and attractor claims remain descriptive rather than measured.
records.next_action: Define one state space, one section, one return rule and one reproducible dataset.
records.exit_condition: A repository artifact generates a return map and records recurrence statistics.

records.reason: Concept maps exist, but graph coverage, orphan detection and connected components were not executable.
records.risk_if_ignored: Documents continue to multiply without measurable integration.
records.next_action: Generate a deterministic forest, DOT graph and attention queue from the JSON matrix.
records.exit_condition: The builder completes with zero validation errors and emits both artifacts.

records.reason: The current calendar repository is strong on Maya and Inca material but does not yet provide sourced comparable records for several other places.
records.risk_if_ignored: Cross-cultural claims may be generalized from only two nuclei.
records.next_action: Add candidate regions as TOKEN_VAZIO and promote them only after source, method, period and uncertainty are registered.
records.exit_condition: At least three additional regions have source-bounded records without forced equivalence.

records.reason: Angular correction is documented, but site epoch, coordinate uncertainty, restoration history and error propagation are incomplete.
records.risk_if_ignored: A visually close alignment may be reported with more precision than the data permit.
records.next_action: Create one full worked example with coordinates, epoch, horizon model and uncertainty interval.
records.exit_condition: The worked example is reproducible from declared inputs.

records.reason: The located prime note does not provide a formal bridge to cosmology, calendar geometry or physical observables.
records.risk_if_ignored: Low; exclusion prevents unsupported numerical association.
records.next_action: Keep outside physical claims until an explicit modular map and theorem candidate exist.
records.exit_condition: A formal definition, proof target and computational test are present.

records.reason: Toroidal, sqrt3 and attractor claims are documented at overview level and need source-to-result traceability.
records.risk_if_ignored: Architecture labels may outrun executable evidence.
records.next_action: Attach exact code paths, build commands, hashes and outputs to every quantitative claim.
records.exit_condition: Each quantitative claim resolves to a code artifact and reproducible result.

records.reason: Real observations, candidates and symbolic records coexist and require machine-readable claim classes.
records.risk_if_ignored: Candidate or symbolic entries may be mistaken for confirmed catalogue objects.
records.next_action: Add provenance_class and verification_state to every row and reject ambiguous records.
records.exit_condition: Schema validation reports zero unclassified catalogue entries.

records.reason: The geometric constant is useful across geometry and dynamics, but it must not be confused with unrelated physical coefficients.
records.risk_if_ignored: Numerical resemblance may be promoted to causal identity.
records.next_action: Compare a fixed sqrt(3)/2 model with a free-parameter model and retain negative results.
records.exit_condition: Model comparison quantifies whether fixing the factor improves or worsens explanatory performance.

records.reason: Contradictions, null limits and non-matches are necessary for scientific memory.
records.risk_if_ignored: The forest becomes a positive-claim catalogue rather than a research system.
records.next_action: Require null, contradiction and TOKEN_VAZIO counts in generated reports.
records.exit_condition: Every report displays evidence-state distribution including negative states.
